description: This file defines the ClaimService class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It provides methods to access claim data through the ClaimDao object and generate reference IDs based on the current date and next ID in the claim sequence.

classes.name: ClaimService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing claims, including generating reference IDs and interacting with the claim data access object.

methods.name: getClaimDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ClaimDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Generates a unique reference ID based on current date and the next claim ID.
